Levels & EXP

The EXP formula, the level cap, Rare Candy, Training Camp and trades.

Tallgrass uses Gen 5's scaled EXP: beating something stronger than you pays more, farming weaklings pays less. Then it's multiplied by the idle pace (×0.08), so a battle pays about a fifth of the main games.

Base
(⌊yield × foe level ÷ 5 × ((2 × foe level + 10) ÷ (foe level + your level + 10))^2.5⌋ + 1) × 1.5
Species you own
×1.5
Foe look
Shiny ×1.5, Void ×2, Prismatic ×3, Void Prismatic ×4
Exp. Charm
+10% per level
Lucky Egg / Luxury Ball
×2 / ×1.1
Didn't fight
Living party members that didn't battle get half
Bosses
Pay EXP as if 3 levels higher

Level cap

Your next Gym sets the cap: its ace's level + 3. Beating it raises the cap; with every badge there's none. Anyone already above it keeps their level.

Next GymAce levelYour cap
1. Matt (Glow Badge)1821
2. Juan (Tide Badge)2831
3. Flannery (Ember Badge)3841
4. Phoebe (Spirit Badge)4851
5. Glacia (Frost Badge)5861
6. Winona (Feather Badge)6871
7. Wattson (Dynamo Badge)7881
8. Drake (Legend Badge)8891
All 8 badges–100
  • Rare Candy: +1 level (not past the cap). It drops from wilds, bosses, raids and prizes; the Mart doesn't sell it.
  • Training Camp (upgrade): PC Pokémon get 5% of the party's EXP per level, up to your lead's level − 1.
  • Day Care: each wild encounter gives both Pokémon in a pen about 1/40 of a level.
  • Trades: a Pokémon above your cap "shadow drops" to it and grows back with each new badge.
